name: io.github.pat-the-cat-cat/part-guide
title: Part Guide
description: Monthly PC-parts popularity rankings: best-in-category, compare, and trending, from live data.

tools.name: best_in_category
tools.description: Answers "what is the best / most popular / most used X". Returns a one-sentence answer, the #1 and #2, the cheapest product in the top five, the fastest riser, the top 10, the sources the estimate is based on and the page URL. Measures and sources are stated in each answer. Optional region, brand ("AMD", "Intel", "NVIDIA"), os ("macOS", "Windows") and budget_usd.

category.description: Category in plain words, e.g. "gaming mouse", "CPU", "graphics card", "laptop for video editing", or an id from list_categories.

region.description: Optional region: a code (US, CA, UK, EU, SE, NO, DK, AU), a market (na, eu, uk, nordics, au) or a name like "Sweden". Omit for the global ranking.

budget_usd.description: Also return the most picked product at or under this US price

month.description: Month as YYYY-MM. Defaults to the latest month.

tools.name: get_ranking
tools.description: The ranked list for one category and month: retailer bestseller positions or estimated shares, comparable movement, US price, and sources. Optional region.

category.description: Category in plain words, e.g. "gaming mouse", "CPU", "graphics card", "laptop for video editing", or an id from list_categories.

region.description: Optional region: a code (US, CA, UK, EU, SE, NO, DK, AU), a market (na, eu, uk, nordics, au) or a name like "Sweden". Omit for the global ranking.

month.description: Month as YYYY-MM. Defaults to the latest month.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find products by name, e.g. "9800X3D", "RTX 5070", "Superlight". Returns ids and names to use with get_product and compare_products.

query.description: Product name or part of it

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product: its rank and share in each category it appears in, 12-month share history, and prices by region with shop links. Accepts an id or a name.

region.description: Price region: US, CA, UK, EU, SE, NO, DK, AU. Omit for all.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Side-by-side popularity, trend and US price for 2 to 5 products, e.g. ["RTX 5070", "RX 9070 XT"].

tools.name: trending
tools.description: Products that gained or lost the most share this month, across all categories or one section (pc, peripherals, laptops).

month.description: Month as YYYY-MM. Defaults to the latest month.

tools.name: meta_build
tools.description: The #1 product in every category of a section put together, with the total US price. pc = a full PC build, peripherals = the full desk setup.

month.description: Month as YYYY-MM. Defaults to the latest month.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category Part Guide ranks, with ids, search names, filters and page URLs, plus the months available.
